scope: Entire proposal read, all seven proof contracts and complete project/rubric/source/implementation scope audited. Primitive calculations independently reconstructed without author calculation helpers.
result: approved for nine-file authoring; final acceptance remains pending
comparison_labels: baseline every boundary and entire open cell

proof_judgments.compliance: Finite mean identity uses consistency, no interference, binary monotone receipt and exclusion separately; sample Wald need not be unbiased.
proof_judgments.cluster_variance: Three-of-six covariance identity gives variance 37/9. Expected Neyman 43/9 exceeds it by S_tau^2/6; a realized estimate need not dominate.
proof_judgments.ANCOVA: Normal-equation and FWL solutions agree for all twenty assignments; exact refitting under the frozen-outcome sharp null is distinct from oracle regeneration.
proof_judgments.null_inversion: Affine contrasts give a finite complete partition of R through the two linear factors of the squared difference. Inclusive ties evaluated at every root and both tails. Acceptance p>alpha yields [1,9] and (-infinity,1] union [7,infinity). These are not generic heterogeneous-CACE confidence sets.
proof_judgments.direct_effect: For compliers D(z)=z, so delta(z-D(z)) vanishes for every observable assignment. Receipt effect at fixed z changes by -delta; every [3,5] target has an admitted witness.
proof_judgments.external_transfer: Mandatory actual-paper audit and execution/access branch are explicit. Synthetic benchmarks do not constitute executed external replication.

source_scope: Reuse four source IDs through three verified records. No fresh primary-body inspection in this design audit.

post_author_independent_finding.origin: Independent project quadratic-root oracle, confirmed by root
post_author_independent_finding.issue: Initial blueprint/factor enumeration included22/5 from an identically tied comparison, inconsistent with prose that such comparisons add no isolated roots. Overpartition was mathematically harmless for probabilities/sets.
post_author_independent_finding.decision: Use minimal comparison-root partition. Skip lines equal to plus/minus the observed line; remove22/5, retain18 genuine baseline roots.
post_author_independent_finding.root_independent_route: Directly formed every squared-comparison quadratic from twelve observed rows and solved with exact rational discriminants, skipping identically zero polynomials. Verified every retained root, open cell and both tails against[1,9].
post_author_independent_finding.implementation_status: Resolved in final nine-file author freeze; root inspected final model/manuscript and complete checker, one quiet API passed. Separate peer final validation pending.
